name: grokbot-messages
description: Read and (with per-message confirmation) send Google Messages from your own paired phone via Google Messages for Web.

GOOGLE_MESSAGES_SESSION_PATH.description: Path to the encrypted session file

GOOGLE_MESSAGES_SESSION_KEY.description: Passphrase (16+ characters) encrypting the session file

GOOGLE_MESSAGES_PAIRING_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Public base URL at which the connector's single-use pairing page is reachable from your browser (defaults to a local http://127.0.0.1 address).
